name: Separated Cooperative Additions from Two Hall Copies
definition: Translate Hall's 299-concept cornerless family $C_H$ and its repair tip 183 by the all-one word, so the certified repaired peeling ends at zero; call the translated family $C$ and tip $v$. On two disjoint twelve-coordinate blocks joined by the path $T_\ell=\{1^k0^{\ell-k}:0\le k\le\ell\}$, take $G_\ell=(C\times\{0\}\times\{0_Z\})\cup(\{0\}\times C\times\{1_Z\})\cup(\{(0,0)\}\times T_\ell)$ with tips $a_\ell=(v,0,0_Z)$ and $b_\ell=(0,v,1_Z)$.
parameters: For every $\ell\ge0$, $|G_\ell|=597+\ell$ and its isometric dimension is $24+\ell$. The certificate instantiates $\ell=0$ and $\ell=3$.
properties: $G_\ell$ is cornerless ample. Each one-tip extension is ample and nonpeelable because it retains the other Hall copy as a proper pc-minor. Adding both tips gives a corner-peelable ample family. The acquired supports are disjoint four-sets, and the completed cubes have distance $8+\ell$ even though the additions cooperate.
